children: U.S. building products distributor's fiscal Q3 sales rose 8.5%, a slight miss versus analyst expectations
Adjusted net income and adjusted EBITDA for fiscal Q3 both beat analyst estimates
Company posted a small net loss due to higher SG&A and an unusual inventory provision
Bluelinx expects Q4 specialty product gross margin between 17.5% and 18.5%
Company sees Q4 structural product gross margin between 9.0% and 10.0%
Bluelinx expects Q4 average daily sales volumes to be slightly lower than Q4 2025 and Q3 2026
SPECIALTY PRODUCTS - Co said specialty product sales rose due to Disdero Lumber sales and higher pricing, partially offset by lower volumes
STRUCTURAL PRODUCTS - Co said structural product sales increased due to higher pricing and volumes for lumber and panels
UNUSUAL INVENTORY PROVISION - Co recorded a $2.9 mln inventory provision for discontinued inventory from a strategic brand and vendor change
*Applies to a deviation of less than 1%; not applicable for per-share numbers.
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction supplies & fixtures peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for BlueLinx Holdings Inc. is $84.00, about 6.7% above its November 2 closing price of $78.74
The stock recently traded at 30 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 38 three months ago
